purpose: Research evidence only; this file is outside build_catalogue.py source globs. The goal is 400 genuinely installable families, never 400 links or archive variants.
counting: Unchanged count_packs.py: available or manual with exact verified archive; resolutions, formats, mirrors, regions and components of a project count once. RAR, ROM patches, shaders, system fonts, announcements and unverified links do not count.

discovery.page_result: 475 HTTP 403; no protection bypass or invented download links.
discovery.ps2_selection: Only free file links recovered from existing source trails. Paid access, rehosts without established author distribution, password/split archives, folder/page-only links and creator warnings about old PCSX2 hashes were not promoted.
discovery.ps2_result: Pending exact artifact review; candidates alone do not change availability.
discovery.scope_review: Before promotion, candidate source completeness is retained explicitly: complete only when upstream marks complete, partial for WIP/unknown/partial; clearly named standalone UI/HUD projects are UI. This does not make a candidate available.

remaining_resolved_mapped_links.limits: Exclude 17 explicitly legacy-hash CCKrizalid files, paid shops, password/split bundles, Xbox format releases and already verified entries. OneDrive pages are not downloadable archives through the existing fetcher. Three original Pixeldrain candidates are verified separately.

entries.title: Call of Duty: Roads to Victory
entries.reason: The author's retrospective shows CoD beta/restoration/reskin experiments, not a published CoD texture archive. The 82nd Airborne download explicitly targets Medal of Honor Heroes 2. No validated CoD pack after English, French, Portuguese, Chinese, title and ULUS10218 searches; this is not a claim that none can exist.

entries.title: New Style Boutique 3 / Style Savvy Styling Star — Improved Texture Pack
entries.reason: Creator reports 62,421 textures / 8.94 GB, tested EUR v1.0.0 on Azahar, other regions untested. Exact archive inspection was stopped by HTTP 403 (research run 39409327497); no title ID or contents inferred. ReShade/OpenGL settings are separate PC effects. Preloading is explicitly discouraged by the creator.

entries.title: Super Robot Wars UX HD
entries.reason: Known reference S132, not a new discovery. Original post marks Japanese upscale complete and links a 4.68 GB MEGA file. Accessible page extraction did not retain the complete file key; no key or compatible title ID is invented. Historical partial English translation is a different RomFS project.

entries.title: Dillon's Dead-Heat Breakers HD
entries.reason: Known reference S131. Creator specifies USA and 3.12 GB, omitting Mii faces/animal variants, staff messages and jukebox assets. Full original MEGA file key and actual archive identity remain unverified; no whole-game or French support claim.

entries.title: Super Mario Maker 3DS Chinese HD UI
entries.reason: 2,928 PNGs under Japanese title 00040000001A0300, partial Chinese UI/font/Mashiko artwork. Requires an external Chinese 1.05 patch and system-font setup; repository includes NAND .app modules. Do not install system modules or treat this as a vanilla-game texture profile. No licence inferred.

entries.title: Persona PSP French HD overlay
entries.reason: French translation requires a game patch. Optional script combines seven translated textures with Ryuubu's already catalogued HD UI; creator says that base pack cannot be redistributed. Not an independent HD family or a vanilla retail profile.

entries.title: Jeanne d'Arc French translation
entries.reason: xdelta/ISO patch and native GIM assets for ULUS10261, not PPSSPP texture replacement. Outside the plain texture adapter.

entries.title: Gran Turismo PSP HD project
entries.reason: Repository inspection found the project README without a usable released texture archive.

entries.title: Skies of Arcadia Legends HD continuation
entries.reason: Creator describes 42,495 textures / 22.7 GB on the working machine and a continuation of Bighead/frozenwings. Public repository contains comparison-gallery images and documentation, not the proposed UI/character/environment texture releases. Existing Skies families are not recounted.

entries.title: Metroid Other M HD project
entries.reason: Roadmap and documentation; no deployable texture archive. Redux/control patches are separate from PNG/DDS replacements.

entries.title: Metroid Prime 2 Echoes widescreen HUD
entries.reason: Modifies GGuiSys.pak FRME/Standard.ntwk geometry for NTSC and experimental PAL. Uses other texture projects in screenshots; not a plain texture archive.

entries.title: Wii Party HD
entries.reason: Repository holds screenshots and instructions pointing to a protected forum, not a texture archive. Screenshot disc IDs are not sufficient pack/region evidence.

entries.title: SWBF2:UC PC PS2 Texture Pack 6.2
entries.reason: PyroMann is BioTes, the same creator release integrated earlier today. No extra family is added for the forum announcement, UC use, version, or button choices.

entries.title: CronicCanabis88 multi-system release announcement
entries.reason: Original creator announces future PPSSPP/PCSX2/Dolphin/DuckStation work and a public pCloud host, without establishing a specific compatible downloadable file in this post. Dreamcast or DuckStation files do not imply compatibility with the embedded adapters.

entries.title: Maximo Ghosts to Glory (MaximoCapcom)
entries.reason: The flat ZIP has no serial. The original Spanish creator post explicitly claims all game versions; existing database identities retain confirmation. 1,340 PNGs passed native import. No region-specific rendering is claimed.

entries.title: LOTR Two Towers (MaximoCapcom)
entries.reason: Creator specifies Spain PAL, not arbitrary PAL. PCSX2 GameIndex maps the Spanish edition to SLES-51256; the formerly inferred SLES-51252 profile is removed. Partial icons/characters/environments only.

entries.title: LOTR Return of the King (MaximoCapcom)
entries.reason: 1,078 PNGs pass native import, but the flat ZIP has no serial and creator only specifies PAL. No English/French/Spanish edition is inferred from the creator location. The manual reference is retained without verified availability.

entries.title: Castlevania Symphony of the Night HD x4
entries.reason: Recent original creator posts describe about 100,000 textures / 10 GB for SLUS-00067, explicitly Beetle PSX HW only. Experimental static extraction, reconstructed background tiles, recreated text and restyled characters. Accessible post content exposes no usable download URL; no file format, loader compatibility or installation is inferred from the announcement. This is not DuckStation data.
